narrative.summaryIntro:
Kedarnath Temple is situated in the Himalayan mountain range at an elevation of 3,583 meters, in the Rudraprayag district of Uttarakhand. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, it is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and forms part of the Char Dham pilgrimage circuit. The temple attracts pilgrims year-round despite its challenging high-altitude location.

The present temple structure dates back to the 8th century and is attributed to Adi Shankaracharya. Built with stone in a traditional Himalayan architectural style, the temple stands as a testament to ancient engineering and spiritual devotion in one of India's most sacred mountain regions.
